Name: Campgrounds
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784823455-1447562717.png[/img][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial]Campgrounds is an expansion that adds a new location, the Cindersap Forest Park, along with many different camping related mechanisms. It also introduces a new character, named Clementine (Clem for short), who maintain the park and serves as your guide to camping.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]This mod also serves as a framework for other mod authors, allowing them to create their own[/font][/size][size=3][font=Arial] custom campsites, park visitors, tents and campfire foods. See the [url=https://floogen.github.io/Campgrounds]documentation here[/url] for details on how to get started with creating a [/font][/size][size=3][font=Arial]Campgrounds addon.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784823455-989812525.png[/img][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial]To [/font][/size][size=3][font=Arial]get started with Campgrounds, you must first wait until Spring 14 (or any day after) and exit your farmhouse. An event will play introducing you to Clem, who will explain she is taking over the abandoned camping park just south of your farm (right next to the Secret Woods).[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]If you would like to play Campgrounds immediately on a new save without waiting, enable the [/font][/size][size=3][font=Arial][b]SkipCampgroundsIntroRequirement[/b] setting to bypass that requirement.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]After being introduced to Clementine, visit the[/font][/size][size=3][font=Arial] Cindersap Forest Park by following the same path to the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Secret_Woods]Secret Woods[/url] (right before the entrance).[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784784603-1275346048.png[/img][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784823458-79762099.png[/img][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial]Once at the park, you may notice a few things![/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]The first is the office in the center, which serves as Clementine's home and her shop. Be sure to stop inside, as Clem will give you a quick tutorial on how to start camping (along with the necessary supplies)![/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784780696-1574441426.gif[/img][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]Just outside the shop's door is the campsite board (note the yellow flag), which will be your primary method for traveling to campsites.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]Around the park there are three smaller boards with "?" marks. These boards are repair signs for the visitor spots, which are currently overgrown and in dire need of fixing up![/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784782828-1425532181.gif[/img][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]These spots can be fixed by interacting with the boards. Each site has a different cost to repair, with the South-West one being the cheapest to repair.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]Visitors can start appearing at each spot, once they are repaired. These visitors can be anyone from passing travelers, merchants or even the villagers of Stardew Valley themselves.[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]Currently Campgrounds only adds a few visitors on a set schedule, but more are planned. Additionally, any mod can schedule their own visitors to appear by following the [url=https://floogen.github.io/Campgrounds/getting-started/]documentation here[/url].[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]Current visitors:[/font][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Traveling Merchant: Appears on the 8th of every month at the North-West spot.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Abigail, Emily and Maru: Will occasionally camp together at the South-East spot, every 20 to 40 days (if they aren't busy).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Recipe Merchant: Appears on the 18th of every month at the South-West spot. He sells various cooking recipes you haven't learned yet, though they are pricey![/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Arial]Linus: He appears at the South-West spot on the 8th, if he's not busy and the weather is clear.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784823452-1945490688.png[/img][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial]For more details, see the in-game guide (called the Camping Guide) added via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49525]Parchment[/url].[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784783937-1022174516.gif[/img][/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]This guide is given after talking to Clementine inside her shop and another copy can be purchased any time afterwards. It contains everything you need to know about camping, so make sure to give it a read![/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]If you prefer not to lug around a book, you can set a keybind to open the book without it in your inventory. Simply set the keybind in settings, labeled [b]GuideShortcut[/b].[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784823453-1073631060.png[/img][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial]TBF[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/49526/49526-1784824950-1639456066.png[/img][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Arial]Tent sprites were modified based on commissioned art from [url=https://ko-fi.com/whitelotus/commissions]PlatinumCats[/url].[/font][/size]

[size=3][font=Arial]Source code can be [url=https://github.com/Floogen/Campgrounds]found here[/url].[/font][/size]
